chunks: So, when Our command was issued We rescued Hud by Our grace, and those who believed, with him, and saved them from a dreadful doom.
ai.seo_question: How did God save Prophet Hud and his followers from punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of Rahmah (mercy) as the primary mechanism for salvation, distinguishing the faithful from the disbelievers who faced 'Adhab Ghaliẓ' (severe punishment). The deliverance of Hud and his companions serves as a paradigmatic example of how steadfast belief (Iman) ensures protection during the culmination of divine decree (Amruna), a concept frequently linked to the eventual salvation of the faithful in the eschatological context.
